notes: Discontinued commercial digital-signage display (55" UHD IPS, webOS 4.1, part of UH5F-H series also sold as 43/49/75UH5F-H). Sources: LG Business USA solutions page and LG Hong Kong business spec page (manufacturer, consistent on all I/O). RS232C In/Out and IR In are LG's proprietary 3.5mm (TRS-style) mini-jacks, not DE-9 — mapped to trs-3.5 with an rs232 "accepts" tag since rs232/ir have no dedicated mini-jack id in the connector list; note this is an approximation of the physical jack. Audio In/Out are also 3.5mm stereo mini-jacks (trs-3.5). Power: display uses an internal ("Built-in") power supply with a standard detachable IEC C13/C14 country power cord per LG's commercial-display convention (100-240V~ 50/60Hz, 145W max) — exact inlet pin/shell not explicitly itemized on the spec page, so confidence on the power connector specifically is medium; everything else is confirmed directly from manufacturer spec tables. No separate external speaker output terminal is listed (display has no built-in speakers per LG's own spec sheet, despite some third-party resale listings claiming 10Wx2 speakers — manufacturer page does not list a speaker/speaker-out terminal, so it is omitted). No HDMI output. USB 2.0 Type-A is a single host port (bidirectional per USB host convention, though used for content playback content loading, not signal passthrough).
